`MDB_ADDR_BUSY` is an error code in liblmdb's `lmdb.h` (added on the development/master line, returned when the fixed map address is already taken, notably on Windows). I can recall the surrounding error-code range (`-30799`…`-30786`, `MDB_BAD_DBI`/`MDB_LAST_ERRCODE` at `-30780`), but I cannot pin the exact integer assigned to `MDB_ADDR_BUSY` with confidence, and guessing among near values would fabricate a constant.

ANSWER: unknown
